triggers.definition:
CREATE TRIGGER "trg_ticket_account_status_transition_guard" BEFORE UPDATE OF "account_status" ON "ticket" FOR EACH ROW
WHEN NEW."account_status" IS NOT OLD."account_status" AND (
  OLD."account_status" IN ('closed')
  OR NOT COALESCE(
    (OLD."account_status" IS 'active' AND NEW."account_status" IN ('suspended', 'closed'))
    OR (OLD."account_status" IS 'suspended' AND NEW."account_status" IN ('active', 'closed')), 0))
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'ticket.account_status cannot make this move: its state machine does not list it');
END
triggers.name: trg_ticket_account_status_transition_guard

triggers.definition:
CREATE TRIGGER "trg_ticket_escalation_transition_guard" BEFORE UPDATE OF "escalation" ON "ticket" FOR EACH ROW
WHEN NEW."escalation" IS NOT OLD."escalation" AND (
  NOT COALESCE(
    (OLD."escalation" IS NULL AND NEW."escalation" IN ('raised'))
    OR (OLD."escalation" IS 'raised' AND NEW."escalation" IN ('acknowledged'))
    OR (OLD."escalation" IS 'acknowledged' AND NEW."escalation" IS NULL), 0))
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'ticket.escalation cannot make this move: its state machine does not list it');
END
triggers.name: trg_ticket_escalation_transition_guard

triggers.definition:
CREATE TRIGGER "trg_ticket_review_transition_guard" BEFORE UPDATE OF "review" ON "ticket" FOR EACH ROW
WHEN NEW."review" IS NOT OLD."review" AND (
  OLD."review" IN ('APPROVED', 'REJECTED')
  OR NOT COALESCE(
    (OLD."review" IS NULL AND NEW."review" IN ('RETRY', 'APPROVED', 'REJECTED'))
    OR (OLD."review" IS 'RETRY' AND (NEW."review" IS NULL OR NEW."review" IN ('APPROVED', 'REJECTED'))), 0))
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'ticket.review cannot make this move: its state machine does not list it');
END
triggers.name: trg_ticket_review_transition_guard

triggers.definition:
CREATE TRIGGER "trg_ticket_state_transition_guard" BEFORE UPDATE OF "state" ON "ticket" FOR EACH ROW
WHEN NEW."state" IS NOT OLD."state" AND (
  OLD."state" IN ('closed')
  OR NOT COALESCE(
    (OLD."state" IS 'open' AND NEW."state" IN ('open', 'in_progress', 'resolved', 'closed'))
    OR (OLD."state" IS 'in_progress' AND NEW."state" IN ('resolved', 'open'))
    OR (OLD."state" IS 'resolved' AND NEW."state" IN ('open', 'closed')), 0))
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'ticket.state cannot make this move: its state machine does not list it');
END
triggers.name: trg_ticket_state_transition_guard
